newsitem.title: GUYANA: CRICKET-RAIN THREATENS TO WASH OUT TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-RAIN THREATENS TO WASH OUT TEST.

text.p: Persistent rain was threatening to rule out play for a third straight day in the fifth and final test match between India and West Indies on Sunday.
Heavy rain started at the Bourda Ground at 0700 local time on Sunday, some three hours before the scheduled start of the fourth day's play.
India stood on 194-2 after Thursday's opening day. Play on Friday and Saturday was abandoned because of the weather. West Indies lead the series 1-0.
